title: 连接腾讯企点营销云
description: 填写企业管理员提供的成员密钥和业务空间 ID，即可使用业务分析、人群圈选、选品配券等能力。WorkBuddy 将配置保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，连接时通过请求头发送给营销云 MCP 服务。请勿在聊天中发送密钥。
description_en: Enter the member key and business space ID provided by your administrator to use business analytics, audience segmentation, and product and offer selection. WorkBuddy stores the configuration locally under ~/.workbuddy and sends it to the Marketing Cloud MCP service in request headers. Do not share the key in chat.
docLabel: 如何获取成员密钥与业务空间 ID？
docLabel_en: How to get the member key and business space ID

fields.label: 成员密钥 SecretKey
fields.placeholder: 粘贴企业管理员提供的成员密钥 SecretKey
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the member SecretKey provided by your administrator
fields.description: 只填写密钥本身，不要加 Bearer 前缀。密钥失效时请联系管理员重新生成，并在此更新。
fields.description_en: Enter only the key, without the Bearer prefix. If it becomes invalid, ask your administrator to regenerate it and update this field.

fields.label: 业务空间 ID
fields.placeholder: 填写本次使用的业务空间 ID
fields.placeholder_en: Enter the business space ID to use
fields.description: 请向企业管理员确认目标空间；该空间必须属于密钥对应的企业，切勿填写空间名称。
fields.description_en: Confirm the target space with your administrator. It must belong to the corporation associated with the key. Enter the ID, not the space name.
